clauses.reason: Refuse lost recorded merge authority before the branch advances.

updates.rationale: Checking prepared provenance at commit time prevents an avoidable immutable history failure.
updates.statement: During a recorded Signetum synchronization or admission merge, the commit check matches the pending MERGE_HEAD and candidate parents to that operation and requires exactly its prepared Signetum trailers. Refusal names git commit --no-edit and batch-continue for a batch. Ordinary commits and unrelated merges retain their existing rules.

decisions.reason: The incident demonstrates that detecting lost trailers only at the next operation creates invalid immutable history. Record the prepared authority before merging and check the actual candidate commit in the existing hook, matching the in-progress source and first parent. Comparing exact Signetum trailers preserves provenance while allowing ordinary subject text and Git conflict comments. Documentation alone did not prevent git commit -m; checking arbitrary merges would exceed the recorded operation's authority. Reopen if Git no longer exposes pending merge identity during the reference transaction.

transaction.reason: Apply the owner's approved commit-time preservation of prepared merge trailers.
